title: Named feature requirements
description: review(request) validates all fields before reporting. Each named rule has exactly three alternatives; at least one must match. Locked feature values must also match. Output failed_rules and locked_failures always describe current in input feature/rule order. inspect returns no proposal. complete retains a conforming current; otherwise returns the first conforming Boolean vector in feature order (False before True), or unavailable with null proposal. changes lists changed names in feature order. Repeated/contradictory literals within a rule are allowed. Empty rules are true. No mutation; invalid inputs raise ValueError, text unspecified. CLI reads one JSON request and prints the report.
